tasks.title: Create the first fixture artifact
tasks.goal: Materialize the first behavior as a committed text artifact.
deliveredBehaviors: build/one.txt exists and contains one followed by a newline
build/checkpoint-red exists until the independent cleanup task removes it

acceptanceCriteria.description: The first artifact has the exact specified bytes.

tasks.title: Build on the merged first task
tasks.goal: Prove serial campaign ordering while materializing the second artifact.
deliveredBehaviors: the task-2 worktree already contains task 1's merged artifact
build/two.txt exists and contains two followed by a newline

acceptanceCriteria.description: Both the dependency artifact and second artifact have their exact bytes.
argv: test "$(cat build/one.txt)" = one && test "$(cat build/two.txt)" = two

tasks.title: Create an independent fixture artifact
tasks.goal: Materialize work that can advance alongside the first task.
deliveredBehaviors: build/three.txt exists and contains three followed by a newline

acceptanceCriteria.description: The independent artifact has the exact specified bytes.

tasks.title: Create a second independent fixture artifact
tasks.goal: Advance beside a failing checkpoint and remove the temporary phase marker.
deliveredBehaviors: build/four.txt exists and contains four followed by a newline

acceptanceCriteria.description: The second independent artifact has the exact specified bytes.

tasks.title: Create the post-checkpoint fixture artifact
tasks.goal: Exercise re-gating when two checkpoint descendants integrate in order.
deliveredBehaviors: build/five.txt exists and contains five followed by a newline

acceptanceCriteria.description: The post-checkpoint artifact has the exact specified bytes.
